{{Quote|Sluis Control communications, we have an incoming call from Coruscant for Captain Solo. Is he with you?|Sluis Control Communications patch through a call to Han Solo|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Sluis Control Communications''' was a group active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Sluis Control Communications forwarded a call from [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on Sluis Van.
